stories.title: Ben Gvir contro i registi di Naza premiato a Venezia: “Siete una vergogna, andatevene”

en.title: Ben Gvir attacks Naza film directors awarded at Venice: "You are a disgrace, leave"
en.summary: An Israeli official criticized filmmakers whose work was awarded at the Venice Film Festival, accusing them of defaming military personnel and calling them a dishonor to their nation.

stories.title: Guerra sul confine dell’Europa: Mosca bombarda una stazione alla frontiera con la Polonia

en.title: War on Europe's border: Moscow strikes railway station at Polish frontier
en.summary: Russian forces attacked a train station near the Poland border, though an EU delegation on a preceding train escaped harm. Polish officials characterized the incident as an escalation.

stories.title: Oman, 'annullato incontro previsto per domani tra i Paesi del Golfo e l'Iran'

en.title: Oman: scheduled meeting between Gulf countries and Iran cancelled for tomorrow
en.summary: A planned diplomatic gathering involving Gulf nations and Iran was cancelled, though organizers stated their commitment to fostering dialogue supporting regional stability and cooperation.

stories.title: Ben Gvir contro i registi di Naza, 'siete una vergogna, andatevene'

en.title: Ben Gvir attacks Naza film directors: "you are a disgrace, leave"
en.summary: An Israeli official criticized filmmakers awarded at Venice Film Festival, suggesting their associates were aligned with Hamas and dismissing their work as dishonorable.

stories.title: Il centrosinistra di Andersson in testa in Svezia, arretra l'ultradestra

en.title: Andersson's centre-left ahead in Sweden, far-right retreats
en.summary: Early exit polls show the social democratic-led coalition receiving 51.3 percent of the vote in Swedish elections, while the far-right loses ground.

stories.title: Da Woman Unknown a Naza, i film di Venezia in sala

en.title: From Woman Unknown to Naza, Venice films arrive in cinemas
en.summary: Films from the Venice festival are being released in theaters, with titles including a film starring Pattinson in October and another featuring Malkovich in November.

stories.title: Centinaia di cittadini rendono omaggio ad Emma Bonino in Campidoglio

en.title: Hundreds of citizens pay tribute to Emma Bonino at the Campidoglio
en.summary: Hundreds gathered at Rome's Campidoglio to honor Emma Bonino, with a European flag placed on her coffin and remarks from her sister Domenica.

stories.title: L'ultimo saluto a Emma Bonino: le voci delle donne che le hanno reso omaggio

en.title: Final farewell to Emma Bonino: voices of women who paid tribute to her
en.summary: Hundreds visited the Campidoglio throughout the day to honor the radical party leader, with the EU flag draped over her coffin amid flowers and wreaths.

stories.title: Schlein alla festa del Pd: “Pronti a vincere le primarie Elezioni? Prima possibile”

en.title: Schlein at PD party: "Ready to win primaries Elections? As soon as possible"
en.summary: The party secretary stated the party is prepared to accelerate efforts, emphasizing program development before coalition building and grassroots engagement. She confirmed continued support for Ukraine.

stories.title: Droni russi colpiscono al confine tra Polonia e Ucraina, Varsavia: "Escalation russa"

en.title: Russian drones strike at Poland-Ukraine border, Warsaw: "Russian escalation"
en.summary: Russian drones attacked a train heading to Warsaw near the border, prompting Lithuania to close its airspace and NATO to launch patrol fighter jets. The US called for Ukrainian territorial concessions for peace.

stories.title: Raid russo vicino alla Polonia: droni colpiscono un camion e la locomotiva di un treno

en.title: Russian raid near Poland: drones strike truck and train locomotive
en.summary: Russian drone attacks hit infrastructure close to the Polish border, including a truck near a checkpoint and a passenger train locomotive in the Volyn region. Russia claims it targeted facilities used for military cargo transport from Europe.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina-Russia, news. Kiev: raid su treno al confine con Polonia, allarme anche su convoglio con consiglieri di sicurezza europei

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, news. Kyiv: raid on train at Poland border, alert also on convoy with European security advisers
en.summary: A train near the Poland border was attacked in a Russian raid, with former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson and Italian official Fabrizio Saggio reported aboard. Poland's premier called the escalation a fact; Moscow claimed the railways transported military supplies from Europe.

stories.title: Progetti speciali e nuove giostre, Zamperla punta ai 130 milioni di fatturato

en.title: Special projects and new rides, Zamperla targets 130 million revenue
en.summary: The multinational company celebrates 60 years and introduced a new attraction called Hypnosiz, with ongoing work for Disney and Universal as well as multi-year contracts.

stories.title: Stress emergente, l’Aidp in prima linea

en.title: Emerging stress, Aidp in the front line
en.summary: Aidp is addressing the issue of return-to-work stress, which remains under-explored in established workplace practices but is widely felt in companies. The organization has begun developing solutions to tackle this concern.

stories.title: Alberto Fassi: «Per fare impresa, non smettere mai di sognare»

en.title: Alberto Fassi: "To do business, never stop dreaming"
en.summary: Legami founder Alberto Fassi discusses his entrepreneurial vision and two special projects: the Dreamland natural park and the book "We are dreamers."

stories.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: piano governativo a fasi per gestire lo stop all’area a caldo e le ripercussioni occupazionali

en.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: government plan in phases to manage the hot area shutdown and employment repercussions
en.summary: Following a Milan Court of Appeal order issued on September 11, the hot section of the former Ilva steel plant in Taranto must cease operations by end of October, prompting a phased government management plan for the shutdown and its employment consequences.
